evals.prompt: I have a 3-minute hackathon demo tomorrow. The app is called CaseBrief AI. It helps public defenders paste police reports and get a plain-English case timeline. The wow moment is highlighting contradictions between witness statements. Write my demo script.
evals.expected_output: A timed three-minute demo script with click path, backup plan, rehearsal checklist, and judge Q&A.
expectations: The output includes timestamps that fit a three-minute presentation.
The output identifies and stages the contradiction-highlighting wow moment.
The output includes a backup plan and at least three likely judge questions.

evals.prompt: We only have 90 seconds for our project pitch. It is a mobile app that helps students find teammates at a hackathon. We have a live demo but Wi-Fi might be bad. Help us rehearse.
evals.expected_output: A concise 90-second presentation plan that adapts the structure, minimizes clicks, and includes a Wi-Fi failure fallback.
expectations: The output adapts timing to 90 seconds rather than using the default three-minute script.
The output includes a minimal click path or slide path.
The output includes a specific fallback for bad Wi-Fi.
